syllabus_topics: Description of motion in Space and Time: Conservation laws and Space-Time Symmetries. Conservation of Energy (Mechanics), Linear Momentum, and Angular Momentum. Isolated systems. Kinetic and potential energies.
Internal and external forces: Center of Mass. Work and Torque. Conservative and dissipative systems.
System Stability: oscillations. Simple harmonic and damped oscillations.
Fluid Dynamics: ideal fluid, continuity equation, Bernoulli's equation.
Thermodynamic system. Work and heat. Heat capacity, specific heat and latent heat. States of matter. Phase transitions. Temperature. Heat transfer: convection, conduction, radiation.
The ideal gas. Kinetic theory of gases. Temperature and kinetic energy. Specific heat at constant volume and constant pressure.
Energy and Entropy. Principles of Thermodynamics. Reversible and irreversible transformations. Heat engines.
assessment_rules: Approval can be obtained through tests or a final exam. If students opt for continuous assessment (2 tests), they can still take the final exam to improve their grade. Test resits during the exam period are conditional on having taken the original test. The final grade is the maximum of the exam score or the sum of the two continuous assessment tests (MAP45_total), with a minimum approval score of 9.5. All assessments consist of multiple-choice questions where correct answers receive full credit and incorrect answers receive 0.
